relations.product: 300mm wafer-fab capacity at ESMC, Dresden (70% TSMC-owned joint venture; NXP entitled to 10% of capacity, initial production targeted for 2028)
relations.quote: ESMC is 70% owned by TSMC, with Bosch, Infineon, and NXP each owning 10%. NXP is entitled to 10% of the fab facility capacity. Initial production at ESMC is currently targeted to begin in 2028.
